title: Masked Woman in Cosmic Doorway
description: A woman wearing a metal cage mask stands in a crumbling doorway, her right hand touching a framed red geometric silhouette figure on the left wall. She holds a glowing crystal ball containing a small figure in her left hand, with a surreal purple and black cosmic landscape featuring a red planet and floating elements visible through the open door.
prompt: Surreal black and white ink illustration with selective red and purple coloring, a woman in an ornate dress and metal cage mask stands in a crumbling doorway, her right hand touching a framed red geometric human silhouette on the wall, she holds a glowing crystal ball with a tiny figure inside, behind her a cosmic purple landscape with a large red planet in a starry black sky, intricate linework with dripping ink effects and geometric patterns
